public_rationale: The reported June stress test supports both rounded amounts as monthly API-price equivalents. SemiAnalysis confirms that it exhausted weekly limits with long coding tasks. This supports the contextual reading of attainable usage, but not a guarantee for every subscriber or a claim that the companies actually spend those amounts.
limitations: Numerical results rely on reporting of the original test, not independently reproduced measurements.
API list-price value is not provider cost.
The result is specific to the tested subscription terms and workload.
